tagline: See who changed what in the Magento admin, with old and new values, plus every admin sign-in, the active sessions and alerts for suspicious sign-ins.
key_features: Field-level change history (old and new value)
Catalog, CMS, customers, sales, price rules, configuration and admin users
Login log with failed sign-ins and reasons
Alerts for failed sign-ins, lockouts and new IPs
Admin IP allowlist with a CLI way back in
Passwords and API keys always masked

benefits.title: Answer "who changed this?"
benefits.text: Every admin change is recorded with the admin user, time, IP address and the old and new value of each field.

benefits.title: Spot attacks early
benefits.text: Repeated failed sign-ins, account lockouts and sign-ins from a new IP address or country raise an alert by email and in the admin.

benefits.title: Light on the admin
benefits.text: Tracking runs in the admin only, uses data Magento has already loaded and writes the entries in one insert at the end of the request.

showcase.label: Admin Actions
showcase.title: Every change in one grid
showcase.text: Create, update and delete with admin user, entity, changed fields and IP address. Keyword search, filters, saved views and CSV or XML export.

showcase.label: Change detail
showcase.title: Old and new value per field
showcase.text: Each entry shows exactly which fields changed, with a link to the record and to other changes made in the same request.

showcase.label: Login Log
showcase.title: Every sign-in and failed attempt
showcase.text: Successful and failed sign-ins with the reason, lockouts, sign-ins blocked by the allowlist and sign-outs, with IP address and browser.

showcase.label: Active Sessions
showcase.title: See who is signed in now
showcase.text: Every admin session with IP address, browser, sign-in time and last activity. Terminate one or several; the admin is signed out on their next click.

showcase.label: Notifications
showcase.title: Alerts you can tune
showcase.text: Choose the failed sign-in threshold and time window, new IP and new country alerts, recipients and email templates.

showcase.label: Settings
showcase.title: Retention and IP source
showcase.text: Switch each log on or off, choose how long entries are kept and whether the client IP comes from the web server or Cloudflare.

feature_groups.title: What is logged
items: Products, categories (including moves), CMS pages and blocks
Customers, orders, invoices, shipments, credit memos and comments
Admin users, roles and permissions, mass actions and imports

feature_groups.title: Sign-ins and sessions
items: Successful and failed sign-ins with the reason
Active sessions grid with Terminate and mass Terminate

feature_groups.title: Security
items: Alerts for failed sign-ins from one IP and for lockouts
Alerts for sign-ins from a new IP or country
Admin IP allowlist with single IPs and CIDR ranges, IPv4 and IPv6
Passwords, tokens and API keys stored masked
Changes to the log settings kept by the clean-up

feature_groups.title: Admin and developers
items: Retention in days with a daily clean-up
Exclusions by entity type and configuration path
Extension point for your own entities
